title: Convoy: Integrations
summary: Plan hauls with route maps, weather checks, fuel support, storage, and recovery kits.

blocks.title: Connected Systems
blocks.body: HoloMap marks routes, Logistics prepares cargo, WorldCore explains region risk, and Recovery softens the cost of a failed return.

blocks.title: Practical Pairings
blocks.body: Use HoloMap for waypoints, Logistics for cargo kits, Recovery for failed-route planning, and Terminal records for route intent and rewards.

blocks.title: Fallback Play
blocks.body: Without route overlays or logistics support, keep convoy runs short, label cargo by destination, and place repair supplies at both ends.

blocks.title: Fallback Check
blocks.body: If the helper addon is absent, keep the same order by hand and follow the manual checkpoint.
